detail.longDescription: As COO of Rozas, Matthew Rozas oversees the systems behind a firm that receives about 1,800 calls a week on its main line. He owns finance, HR, marketing, and operations, so he sees exactly where a new lead can slow down: in the gap between someone asking for help and the intake team getting that request into Clio Grow.
